SAIL.d: Steel Authority of India Limited manufactures and sells a broad range of flat and long steel products. It is a state-owned steel producer operating integrated steel plants across the country.

SAILIFE.d: Sai Life Sciences Limited provides drug discovery, development, and manufacturing services. Its customers are global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

SAMMAANCAP.d: Sammaan Capital Limited provides housing loans, loan against property, and corporate mortgage loans in India. It primarily serves retail consumers and real estate developers.

SANSERA.d: Sansera Engineering manufactures complex precision forged and machined components for the automotive and aerospace sectors. Its products include connecting rods, rocker arms, and aerospace components.

SARDAEN.d: Sarda Energy & Minerals manufactures steel, ferro alloys, and generates hydroelectric power for industrial and commercial customers. It operates captive mines to support its integrated metallurgical operations.

SBICARD.d: SBI Cards and Payment Services issues credit cards and manages merchant acquiring services across India. It is a subsidiary of the State Bank of India.

SBIFUNDS.d: SBI Funds Management manages mutual fund schemes and provides investment portfolios for institutional and retail investors. It is a joint venture involving the State Bank of India and Amundi.

SBILIFE.d: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited offers individual and group life insurance products and riders across India. It operates as a joint venture between the State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif.

SBIN.d: State Bank of India provides commercial banking, retail credit, and treasury operations to individuals and corporate entities. It is India's largest state-owned public sector bank.

SCHAEFFLER.d: Schaeffler India manufactures rolling and plain bearings, engine components, and chassis systems for automotive and industrial applications. It is a subsidiary of the global Schaeffler Group.

SCHNEIDER.d: Schneider Electric Infrastructure manufactures heavy electrical equipment including transformers and switchgear for power sector clients. The company operates as a subsidiary of Schneider Electric.

SGMART.d: SG Mart Limited trades in steel and metal products, serving various construction and industrial manufacturing customers.

SHADOWFAX.d: Shadowfax Technologies Limited operates a digital logistics platform providing last-mile and middle-mile delivery services. It serves e-commerce companies, enterprises, and local merchants across India.

SHAILY.d: Shaily Engineering Plastics designs and manufactures high-precision injection moulded plastic components and products. It serves global customers in healthcare, home appliances, and toy industries.

SHILPAMED.d: Shilpa Medicare Limited manufactures and supplies active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates, and finished dosage formulations. It focuses heavily on oncology products and serves global pharmaceutical markets.

SHREECEM.d: Shree Cement Limited manufactures and markets cement and power. It supplies construction materials to infrastructure and housing sectors primarily in India.

SHRIRAMFIN.d: Shriram Finance Limited provides commercial vehicle loans, two-wheeler loans, and personal loans to retail and small business customers across India. It operates as a large non-banking financial company.

SHYAMMETL.d: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited manufactures long steel products, pellets, sponge iron, and ferro alloys, alongside generating power. Its products serve construction, manufacturing, and industrial customers primarily in India.

SIEMENS.d: Siemens Limited provides heavy electrical equipment, automation technology, and digital solutions for industrial and infrastructure markets. It is a subsidiary of the German engineering firm Siemens AG.

SJVN.d: SJVN is a state-owned power generation company engaged in hydroelectric, solar, and wind power projects. It supplies electricity primarily to state distribution utilities in India.

SKYGOLD.d: Sky Gold and Diamonds designs, manufactures, and supplies gold and diamond jewelry on a B2B basis. It serves major jewelry retailers and distributors.

SOLARINDS.d: Solar Industries India Limited manufactures industrial explosives, initiating systems, and defense products for mining and infrastructure sectors. It is a major supplier to domestic coal and infrastructure industries.

SONACOMS.d: Sona BLW Precision Forgings manufactures automotive systems and components, including differential gears and EV traction motors. Its main customers are global passenger and commercial vehicle manufacturers.

SOUTHBANK.d: The South Indian Bank Limited provides retail and corporate banking, treasury operations, and other financial services. It operates primarily through a network of branches and ATMs across India.

SPLPETRO.d: Supreme Petrochem Limited manufactures polystyrene and other petrochemical products, serving packaging, consumer goods, and automotive industries. It is a major domestic producer of polystyrene in India.

SRF.d: SRF manufactures specialty chemicals, fluorochemicals, packaging films, and technical textiles. Its products serve diverse industrial sectors worldwide, including automotive and agriculture.

SUMICHEM.d: Sumitomo Chemical India Limited manufactures and markets a wide range of agrochemicals, household insecticides, and animal nutrition products. Its primary customers are farmers and agricultural businesses.

SUNDARMFIN.d: Sundaram Finance offers financing for commercial vehicles, cars, and construction equipment, alongside home loans and mutual funds. It serves retail and corporate customers across India.

SUNDRMFAST.d: Sundram Fasteners Limited manufactures high-tensile fasteners, powder metal components, and cold extruded parts for automotive and industrial sectors. It is a key supplier to major global vehicle manufacturers.

SUNPHARMA.d: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries manufactures and sells generic and branded pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients. It serves patients and healthcare providers globally.

SUNTV.d: Sun TV Network broadcasts satellite television channels across multiple regional Indian languages and operates radio stations. Its end market consists of television viewers and advertisers.

SUPREMEIND.d: Supreme Industries manufactures a wide range of plastic products, including piping systems, packaging films, and industrial components. It serves the agriculture, building, and industrial sectors.

SUZLON.d: Suzlon Energy Limited manufactures wind turbine generators and provides related installation and maintenance services. It is a major renewable energy solutions provider in India.

SWIGGY.d: Swiggy Limited operates an online food delivery and quick-commerce platform connecting consumers with restaurants and local merchants. It serves retail customers across major Indian cities.

SYNGENE.d: Syngene International Limited provides contract research, development, and manufacturing services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and nutrition companies.

SYRMA.d: Syrma SGS Technology provides electronic manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly, radio frequency identification products, and custom box builds for diverse industries.
